d:
"“Imagine a world where everyone, everywhere has the freedom to participate.”
Closing the Gap is a documentary created by the University of the West of Scotland (UWS). It follows 54 Para athletes and coaches from 15 Commonwealth nations at the pre-Games GAPS camp, hosted by UWS in the week before Glasgow 2026.
Gather. Adjust. Prepare. Sustain (GAPS) is a Commonwealth Sport programme designed to provide Para athletes from across the Commonwealth specialised training support in performance, psychology and physiotherapy, fostering a sense of belonging from being part of a welcoming community.
